fields.exact_degree_program_name: Computer, Communication and Information Sciences, MSc — Software Engineering
fields.research_requirement: 120-ECTS, two-year MSc including a master's thesis
fields.current_program_status: Current; 2027 evaluation criteria and application period are published
fields.bachelors_entry_eligibility: Yes — relevant bachelor's degree, subject to competitive academic and coursework evaluation
fields.international_student_eligibility: Yes — non-EU/EEA applicants may apply and are tuition-fee liable
fields.english_requirement_and_waiver: Aalto English policy applies; an on-site U.S. higher-education degree may satisfy the listed route subject to final document review
fields.minimum_gpa: No universal U.S. numeric floor; 2027 criteria require consistently excellent performance and country/institution-specific interpretation
fields.minimum_gpa_application: Applicant 3.35 must be evaluated under the unpublished U.S.-specific competitiveness interpretation
fields.prerequisite_coursework: Software engineering, project/team work, programming, algorithms/data structures, and databases; related subjects strengthen the application
fields.admissions_model: Competitive study-option evaluation and ranking; only top applicants are admitted
fields.faculty_contact_expectation: No prior supervisor commitment is required
fields.deadline_cycle_label: Explicit Autumn 2027 application period, December 7, 2026 to January 5, 2027
fields.fee_waiver_rules: No waivers; statutory exemptions depend on citizenship or qualifying residence permit
fields.simultaneous_application_rules: One application may include at most two ranked Aalto study options
fields.separate_fees_required: No — one statutory application fee covers the application
fields.tuition: 17,000 EUR per academic year for non-EU/EEA fee-liable students
fields.mandatory_fees: Student and living-cost obligations are additional; exact 2027 amount not captured
fields.funding_model: Small number of competitive Aalto Excellence Scholarships as 100 percent tuition waivers
fields.funding_status: No guaranteed support; the waiver is highly competitive and Aalto provides no additional living-cost scholarship
fields.funding_duration: Tuition-waiver scholarship, if awarded, covers the normative two-year period
fields.funding_conditions: Top-ranked fee-liable applicant, scholarship request during admission, and progress under award terms
fields.funding_international_eligibility: Fee-liable international applicants may compete for the tuition waiver
fields.stipend_amount: 0 — no living-cost stipend from the standard Aalto scholarship
fields.tuition_coverage: 100 percent only if awarded; otherwise 17,000 EUR annually
fields.scholarship_deadlines: Requested within the Autumn 2027 admission application by January 5, 2027
fields.largest_unresolved_question: Would the applicant rank high enough for admission and a full tuition waiver, and what independent source would cover all living and insurance costs?

sources.exact_claim_supported: Current two-year 120-ECTS Software Engineering MSc, 2027 criteria, required preparation, and EUR 17,000 tuition.
Explicit Autumn 2027 dates, one form, maximum two ranked study options, and one-place rules.
EUR 100 statutory fee, residence exemptions, and no fee waivers.
Small number of competitive full tuition waivers, two-year normative duration, and no additional Aalto living-cost support.
